title: Sum of Two Integers
summary: Return the sum of a and b without using the addition or subtraction operators.

contractDetails.constraints: a and b are integers in [−1000,1000]. Use signed two’s-complement semantics on a 32-bit word.

examples.explanation: No bits or carries are present.

constraints: a and b are integers in [−1000,1000]. Use signed two’s-complement semantics on a 32-bit word.
hints: Conceptual: XOR adds two bits without a carry.
Directional: AND identifies positions generating carries.
Implementation: Shift carries left and repeat until none remain. Mask to 32 bits in languages with arbitrary-width integers.
complexityAnalysis: O(w) time and O(1) extra space, with w=32.
